blocks.text: Incident workflows in Agentic SOC allow you to automate and standardize the incident lifecycle according to your organization's operational requirements. By defining rule sets for dispatching incidents to external systems, you can reduce manual administrative effort and maintain data integrity throughout the remediation process.
You can create and manage the list of available incident severities. To learn more, see Configuring Severity Categories.

The Incident Workflows page displays the Auto-Dispatch to External Systems category. It allows you to automatically create items or alerts in Splunk, AWS S3, and CrowdStrike when specific criteria are met.
To learn more, see About Incidents.

For access to incident workflows, your assigned role must include the Read, Create, Edit, and Delete permissions under the Threats App - Incident Settings resource. To learn more, see Creating Custom Roles and Creating & Managing Users.
To configure incident workflow rule sets:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC.
In the left-side navigation, go to Settings > Incident Lifecycle.
Click Incident Workflows.
See image.
The Incident Workflows page appears.
On the Incident Workflows page, in the Auto-Dispatch to External Systems category, click the Add New Rule icon.
See image.
The Auto-Dispatch to External System drawer opens.
In the Auto-Dispatch to External System drawer, enter the following details:
Name: Enter a name for the new rule.
Active: Enable to activate the rule.
Set the criteria:
IF: Define the rule condition that determines which incidents the rule should apply to:
Incident status is: Select the checkbox to add incident statuses that trigger this rule.
Incident severity is: Select the checkbox to add incident severity levels that trigger this rule.
(Optional) Create custom rules for specific fields:
Select a field that the condition should be based on.
Select an operator (e.g., Equals, Contains). Available operators vary depending on the field type, indicated to the left of the field name.
Enter the value that the rule should apply to.
(Optional) Use AND/OR logic to define compound rules.
AND populates the field only if the field meets all conditions in the rule.
OR populates the field if the field meets any of the conditions in the rule.
THEN:
Create a third-party item: Select the outegration for the system you want to trigger.

Create New Outegration: If no outegration is configured for the destination you want to dispatch to, click to open the Connect a New Outegration page and create one. After you create an outegration, it appears in the Create a third-party item in the drop-down menu.
See image.
(Optional) Click New Rule to add a new rule.
Save the rule set to complete the process in one of the following ways:
Click Save to save the rule. Rules evaluate against each new incident created in the system.
From the Save drop-down menu, click Save & Run to save the rule and immediately run the rules against all existing incidents in Agentic SOC.
Click Done.

blocks.text: When managing incident workflow rule sets, you can perform the following actions:

blocks.item: Delete a Rule
To delete a rule:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC.
In the left-side navigation, go to Settings > Incident Lifecycle.
Click Incident Workflows.
The Incident Workflows page appears.
Delete a rule by performing one of the following actions:
To delete a single rule:
In the Conditions section, click the rule you want to delete.
The Auto-Dispatch to External System drawer opens.
In the Auto-Dispatch to External System drawer on the rule you want to delete, click Delete Rule.
See image.
The Delete Rule window appears.
See image.
Click Delete.
To delete all rules:
In the Auto-Dispatch to External Systems category, click the Delete All Rules icon.
See image.
The Delete All Rules window appears.
See image.
Click Delete.
Edit a Rule
To edit a rule:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC.
In the left-side navigation, go to Settings > Incident Lifecycle.
Click Incident Workflows.
The Incident Workflows page appears.
In the Auto-Dispatch to External Systems category, click the Edit icon.
See image.
The Auto-Dispatch to External System drawer opens.
In the Auto-Dispatch to External Systems drawer, make the necessary changes.
Save the rule to complete the process in one of the following ways:
Click Save to save the rule. Rules apply to each new incident created in the system.
From the Save drop-down menu, click Save & Run to save the rule and immediately run the rules against all existing incidents in Agentic SOC.
View Audit Logs
To view incident workflow audit logs:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC.
In the left-side navigation, go to Settings > Incident Lifecycle.
Click Incident Workflows.
The Incident Workflows page appears.
On the Incident Workflows page, in the Auto-Dispatch to External Systems category, click the Edit icon.
See image.
The Auto-Dispatch to External System drawer opens.
On the Incident Workflows page, in the Auto-Dispatch to External Systems drawer, click More > Audit Logs.
The rule's Audit Logs page appears.
On the Audit Logs page, click to expand a log, and drill down into detailed information about the changes made.
See image.
